risks.proof: Close-up shots of front cells under angled light, full rear side, and junction box/connectors.

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history and whether sold as single unit or part of a set.
risks.proof: Seller statement with purchase date/receipt, or photo of multiple matching panels if sold as a set.

risks.risk: No certification or compliance documentation shown, authenticity of brand/build quality uncertain.
risks.proof: Photo of any certification sticker, datasheet, or invoice.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the panel's rear rating label showing wattage, model, Voc/Isc/Vmp/Imp
Photo of the full rear side and junction box/connectors
Close-up of the cell surface for cracks or hotspots
Clarification and photo of the actual battery being referenced, since none appears in the panel photo
Any receipt, warranty card, or certification document
